executionPolicy.selectionRule: Select the lowest-sequence pending item whose dependencies are complete, whose doctrine state is not paused, and whose required approval is granted. Activate it immediately after the prior active item reaches complete or blocked.
executionPolicy.noEligibleItemRule: Stop execution and report the exact unresolved dependency, doctrine pause, or missing David approval. Do not invent substitute work.
executionPolicy.completionRule: An item becomes complete only after every completionGate entry has recorded evidence in this file.
executionPolicy.queueChangeRule: Only David may authorize adding, removing, reordering, or materially changing queue scope. The controller records his decision in this file before execution.
executionPolicy.workerRule: A worker executes only the item ID assigned by the controller, returns evidence, and stops without choosing a successor.
